buckets.title: Fitness & Fatigue
buckets.text: Neither player has a fatigue edge. Workloads are close, 55 games for Linana against 49 for Riera over 14 days, and neither shows a rest or rhythm problem. They last played 2 and 2 days ago respectively.

buckets.title: Motivation & Pressure
buckets.text: A slight edge to Riera on motivation and pressure. Riera has the home support in Buenos Aires, Argentina. When it goes the distance, Riera has won 63% of deciding sets over the past year to Linana's 50%. Offsetting that, both are gaining ground, but Linana faster: +97 Elo over 90 days against +66 for Riera.

buckets.title: Conditions
buckets.text: No clear edge on conditions: two factors pull in opposite directions. Surface Elo versus overall Elo: Riera +27, Linana -1, so Riera is the better fit for Clay. On Clay, Linana has won 65% over the past year (23 matches) to Riera's 57% (28).
